what_to_detect: A static ability adds a card type to the permanents it affects in addition to their other types: a contribution naming a type with no '=' set marker, the permanent keeping every type and subtype it had.
near_miss: A static ability that sets the affected permanent's types outright (its contribution carries the '=' marker), so the earlier types are lost.
record_fields: payload.contributions[].types (the '=' marker of a characteristic set outright)

what_to_detect: A candidate whose cost or target requires a creature type is refused while its controller's only permanents printing that type (or changeling) are not creatures: a noncreature object has no creature types.
near_miss: The same kind of candidate allowed because such a permanent is a creature.

what_to_detect: A resolution that sets or changes a permanent's card types (a type_change event with overwrite) on a permanent holding a supertype in the snapshot: the supertype is not changed by it.
near_miss: A type_change event on a permanent holding no supertype.
